name: SCRUM-9 - System User Table Sorting
objective: Verify ascending and descending sorting for supported System Users columns.
precondition: The System Users screen exposes sortable column headers and multiple records.

steps.description: Sort user records by each supported column in ascending order.
steps.expectedResult: Records are displayed in ascending order and the record count is unchanged.

steps.description: Sort user records by each supported column in descending order.
steps.expectedResult: Records are displayed in descending order and the record count is unchanged.
